**Texere 0.4.8** · 11 November 2026

- **Starting over in an emptied vault.** If you delete everything from a vault where Texere was set up, Texere now starts the setup again from the beginning, as in a new vault, instead of showing "isn't in the vault anymore" for each folder. Your language and modules stay.

Also in this version (from 0.4.7): tags in your PDF++ colours, linked to PDF++; new versions show up on the home page sooner.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
